tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Integration Lead | Java, Spring & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning. Proven expertise in designing data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, code reviews, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity

cover_en.subject: Application: Integration Team Lead
cover_en.hook: vivenu's rapid growth and high-concurrency API-first platform powering global live entertainment brands present an exciting technical challenge. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise REST APIs and backend integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical depth in scalable backend services.

bullets.label: RESTful Endpoints & APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and custom headless APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, designing robust endpoints and custom Interceptors for high-volume enterprise data flows.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Synchronization
bullets.text: Engineered complex PIM-to-platform data pipelines and API migrations across ERP and MDM systems, resolving integration bottlenecks and ensuring seamless data synchronization.

bullets.label: Performance & Troubleshooting
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, optimized transaction speed, and provided rigorous production support and troubleshooting during peak deployment cycles.

bullets.label: Technical Guidance & Collaboration
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, guided junior developers, and collaborated closely with international technical teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my integration and backend expertise can support vivenu.

tailoring.why_company: vivenu is redefining live entertainment technology by handling massive request volumes through its high-performance, API-first platform for global giants like the Grammys and Hockenheimring. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise backend and integration experience to help scale your critical platform connectors and ensure robust system reliability.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to lead and scale high-performance integration infrastructure at vivenu, leveraging my enterprise API and backend expertise.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw vivenu's exciting growth in event ticketing tech. With 5+ years building scalable REST APIs and enterprise integrations at Rockwell and Shell, I'd love to connect regarding the Integration Team Lead role. My CV and cover letter are ready for review.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Integration Team Lead - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Integration Team Lead position at vivenu.

With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise backend services, scalable RESTful APIs, and complex data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical execution in high-volume environments. I am based in Germany with a valid work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to vivenu's platform.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
